Good question. You don’t need to pair it with anything for it to do well.
A ZZ Plant is happy on its own. The main things that help it thrive are simple:
Place it in medium to bright light if possible, though it can adapt to lower light. 
Check the reservoir and refill it about every two months.
Occasionally dust the leaves and rotate the pot a quarter turn once a month so it grows evenly.
Keep it in a stable spot, away from vents or heaters. 
It grows slowly and steadily, so it doesn’t need much attention to stay healthy.
